sentences.text: For serious bleeding, apply firm, direct pressure on the wound with a dressing and keep pressing.
For life-threatening bleeding from an arm or leg that pressure won’t control, apply a tourniquet high on the limb, tighten it until the bleeding stops, and note the time.
Watch for shock, a life-threatening drop in circulation, with pale, cold, clammy skin and a fast, weak pulse.
Lay the person flat, keep them warm, and raise their legs if they aren’t injured.
Don’t give anything to eat or drink to someone seriously hurt.
